shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved as a vertical pillar/column
schematic head atop a columnar body
low-relief arms/hands rendered on the front of the body
incised linear ornament on the body surface
circular/disc motifs in relief or incision
horizontal band(s) encircling the lower body (belt-like)
justification: Both depict a schematic anthropomorphic being conceived as a standing vertical pillar, with a large head surmounting a columnar torso whose arms, discs and belt-like horizontal bands are rendered in shallow relief and incision rather than modelled naturalistically. The biggest difference in content is that A stacks multiple beings including animal-like heads and a fully rendered face with large eyes and mouth, while B shows a single figure with an essentially featureless head bearing only a projecting nose and a body carrying isolated disc motifs.
